findings.claim: Plague is not written to the true embattlement ledger; the roads' believed embattlement view is the only place the two meet
findings.evidence: A plague condition is a crime archetype (pressureModel.js:42) and adds +0.12 crime pressure (:321-327). On mapped worlds the embattlement ramp reads crime pressure for every settlement (pulseKernel.js:2365-2391, crime01 = pIndex crime score), and crime above 0.5 ramps danger at weight 0.3 (spatial/embattlement.js:90,98,199-205; marker-only gate :172-175). So a plague condition can raise true embattlement, which the roads read in every roads preset including RR. There is no plague-specific term, and the stressor-only plague does not do this.
findings.fix: §9 item 3: say plague has no term in the true embattlement ledger, but a plague condition's +0.12 crime pressure is one of embattlement's ramp inputs (crime above 0.5, weight 0.3; pressureModel.js:42,321-327; pulseKernel.js:2365-2391; embattlement.js:98,199-205), so on mapped worlds a DM plague can nudge true danger in a generic way. The roads' believed view (row 16) is then the only plague-specific meeting. Add the same qualifier in §5.5 and in row 16's RR clause.

summary: I read research/sf/plague-system.md whole (1,085 lines) and checked about 780 claims against the host at 81f1cd96 (HEAD read from .git/refs/heads/master; no git command run). Every citation was opened, every quotation re-found, and every number recomputed: care 0.135 and 0.405, onset rolls 0.892, 0.487 and 0.421, the arrival fixed point 0.893d, the DM-band bars 0.64, 0.67, 0.7 and 0.78, mean life 3.48 ticks, echo life 20 ticks, and the per-tick faction deltas. I re-derived every preset flag by evaluating SIMULATION_RULE_PRESETS through normalizeSimulationRules with node, and recomputed all 41 host line counts; all hold. Eleven claims do not hold: 1 WRONG in part, 0 UNSUPPORTED and 10 IMPRECISE. F6 (WRONG in part): the population_friction history event is written when the echo graduates, not at resolution. F2: a plague condition's +0.12 crime pressure feeds the true embattlement ramp, so the believed view is not the only place plague and embattlement meet. F10: the magic stressors drain healing only through their residual condition, the same condition gap the note documents for plague. The rest are smaller: two non-verbatim quotations (F1, F11), a soak described wrongly (F7), a recommended cap stated as a value (F8), and citations that point to the wrong line, section or document (F3, F4, F5), plus two map-module line counts that have grown since the note was read (F9). No conclusion of the note changes. Not checked by execution: the INFERRED dynamics, which were checked as arithmetic only; the healing scale of the causal scan; and the internals of parkArrivals, which the note also declares unread. The note makes no claim about V13-world.md.
